oil.when: 2010, using the SETUP and RESET message center controls
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed.
Press and release SETUP until the message center shows OIL LIFE XXX% HOLD RESET = NEW.
Press and hold RESET for about two seconds, then let go. The display shows OIL LIFE SET TO 100%.
oil.note: Pressing RESET again while OIL LIFE SET TO XXX% is showing lowers the starting value by 10% per press. Leave it at 100% unless you want shorter intervals.
